discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456); reuses their keys. 30 standard searches, snippets only. New: HKDL Eggstravaganza OE (Jan 31), May Donald 85th LE500, Seven Dwarfs HM (Dec); SHDR CNY LEs (3 pins + Duffy box), Happy Birthday OE series (12, held), castle monthly; TDR 2019 pin, Donald birthday, Hot Jungle Summer, Valentine, cherry blossom set, Halloween pair, Tanabata dangle. No holds released. Resellers, value guides and PinTrader.Club not used as evidence.
